title: Reading FC x Marquee Partnership | Marquee
markdown:
[![](https://themarquee.ai/icons/arrow-small-left.svg)Back](https://themarquee.ai/)

![Reading FC × Marquee partnership](https://themarquee.ai/news/reading-fc-partnership.png)

We’re proud to announce a long-term partnership with [Reading FC](https://www.readingfc.co.uk/news/2026/september/30/reading-partners-with-marquee/), with Marquee joining as the club’s official intelligence layer.

Reading is a club with top-flight history and a top-flight future. This partnership is built for the journey back, and for the decisions that will define it. Seasons are won across thousands of decisions, and the clubs that punch above their weight do it by getting those right, faster and clearer than everyone else.

We’ll be assisting Reading across recruitment, pre and post-match analysis, set-pieces and player development, turning external and internal data into answers shaped by the club’s own football DNA.

![Marquee team members at Reading FC’s training ground.](https://themarquee.ai/news/reading-fc-partnership/training-ground.jpg)The Marquee team at Reading FC’s training ground.

Head of AI Stuart Fenton: “We’re rebuilding this club to compete at the level it belongs. That means making sharper decisions, consistently. With Marquee, our staff can pull a comprehensive report or analysis at the click of a button, and ask questions of our data in plain language. It puts real clarity in the hands of the people making the calls.”

Marquee CEO Dean Bracha: “Reading is a big club with a clear direction and the ambition to match. We built Marquee to help clubs win the decisions that change a season, and there’s no better place to prove that than a club on its way back. We’re in this for the long haul.”

Welcome aboard, Reading FC.

## About Marquee

Marquee turns football data into decision-ready insights in seconds, unifying external and internal data and filtering it through each club’s sporting DNA. Professional clubs use Marquee for recruitment, squad planning and analytics. Learn more at [themarquee.ai](https://themarquee.ai/).
